notes.title: Cirno Release Day!
notes.content: Cirno's Perfect Summer Vacation is now released! Come download it and let us know what you think! This is a fun little short visual novel and we hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Setsucon 2020
notes.content: We are presenting another panel at Setsucon 2020 so come join us!

notes.title: Kotoricon 2020 Visual Novel Panel
notes.content: We will be attending Kotoricon January 10th-11th in Sewell, NJ. The panel will be on the 11th at 4 PM, we hope to see you there!
